y-m-67-04.material: Lanƙwasa C: x²+xy+y²=3 (x,y lambobin gaske). Soeun ta yi derivative bisa x ga ɓangarorin biyu, ta samu dy/dx=−(2x+y)/(x+2y) (idan x+2y≠0). Tambayar gida: “Idan x-coordinate na P a C ya zama 1, nemo gangarar tangent a P.”

y-m-67-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ka tantance ko sharadin “x-coordinate ɗin 1 ne” kaɗai yana ƙayyade wuri guda a lanƙwasa.

y-m-67-04.s.s1.r.c: Ka lura cewa dole ne a fara bincika ko an ƙayyade wuri guda.
y-m-67-04.s.s1.r.d: Derivative na farko ne ke ƙayyade gangara. Na biyu sai bayan an ƙayyade wurin.
y-m-67-04.s.s1.explain: Saka x=1 cikin lanƙwasa yana ba y²+y−2=0, wato (y+2)(y−1)=0, don haka y=1 ko −2. Wurare biyu ne, sai a nemo gangara ga kowanne.
y-m-67-04.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ka shigar da maki biyu daban masu integer coordinates a C inda tangent yake layi ɗaya da axis x. (2)

y-m-67-04.s.s2.explain: Idan dy/dx=0, numerator 2x+y=0 ne, wato y=−2x. Saka cikin lanƙwasa: 3x²=3, don haka x=±1, wuraren (1,−2) da (−1,2). Daga wuraren farko, gangara 0 ce a (1,−2), −1 ce a (1,1), saboda haka amsar ta bambanta sai an ƙayyade wurin. (2, 1, 1, 1, 1)

y-m-67-09.title: An warware ∫x ln x dx ta hanyoyi biyu.
y-m-67-09.topic: Hanyoyin integral: kwatanta hanyoyi biyu na amfani da sassan integral.
y-m-67-09.goal: Tabbatar da cewa tsawon lissafi na iya bambanta bisa yadda aka zaɓi u da v′ a amfani da sassan integral, kuma ko hanyar da ta yi kama da ta kasa tana ba da sakamako iri ɗaya idan an sauƙaƙa ta; sannan ka rubuta dalilin zaɓinka.
y-m-67-09.material: Dalibai biyu suna ƙoƙarin nemo integral marar iyaka ∫x ln x dx (x>0; karanta: integral na x ninka logarithm na halitta na x, bisa x) ta amfani da amfani da sassan integral, ∫u v′ dx=uv−∫u′v dx. Jihu ya sa u=ln x, v′=x; Haeun kuma ta sa u=x, v′=ln x. (A ɗauka ka riga ka san integral marar iyaka na ln x ita ce x ln x−x. Ana rubuta ƙayyadaddiyar ƙimar haɗawa da C.)
y-m-67-09.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin zaɓi tare da hujjoji.
y-m-67-09.prereq.1: Ƙa'idar amfani da sassan integral ∫u v′ dx=uv−∫u′v dx
y-m-67-09.s.s1.prompt: Kafin a fara lissafi, wane hasashe ne ya fi dacewa game da hanyoyin biyun?
y-m-67-09.s.s1.hint.0: Ga hanyoyin biyu, rubuta u′ da v, ka kwatanta wanne ya fi sauƙi.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.hint.1: A hanyar Haeun, rubuta abin da za a yi integral domin nemo v.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.o.a: Hanyar Jihu da alama ta fi sauƙi. Asalawar ln x tana ba da 1/x mai sauƙi.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.r.a: Ka kwatanta kuɗin aikin nemo u′ da v tare.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.o.b: Hanyar Haeun ta fi sauƙi. Domin asalawar u=x tana zama 1 tsayayye.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.r.b: Ka duba gefen u′ mai sauƙi kawai, ba ka yi la'akari da aikin nemo v (integral na ln x) ba.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.o.c: Ba zan iya yanke shawarar wacce hanya ta fi sauƙi kafin lissafi ba.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ya jinkirta hukunci kafin gwadawa. Za ka iya jinkirta, amma domin kwatantawa dole ne ka yi hasashe.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.explain: Za ka iya hasashen cewa zaɓin Jihu zai gajarta, domin asalawar u tana sauƙaƙa shi (1/x), kuma ana iya samun integral na v′=x kai tsaye. Amma wannan ba yana nufin hanyar Haeun ba za ta yiwu ba.
y-m-67-09.s.s1.acc.0: Yana yiwuwa a jinkirta hukunci kafin lissafi, amma yin hasashe sannan duba shi ta lissafi yana taimaka wa kwatantawa.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.prompt: Haeun ta lissafa da u=x da v=x ln x−x, ta samu I=∫x ln x dx=x(x ln x−x)−∫(x ln x−x)dx=x²ln x−x²−I+x²/2. I ya sake bayyana a gefen dama. Me zai faru da wannan hanya?
y-m-67-09.s.s2.hint.0: Gwada ɗaukar I a matsayin abin da ba a sani ba, ka duba ko za ka iya sake tsara lissafin da ke da I a ɓangarorin biyu.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.hint.1: Asalawa sakamakon da ka samu, ka duba ko ya koma x ln x.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.o.a: I ya sake bayyana, saboda haka wannan hanyar ba za ta iya warware shi ba.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.r.a: Wannan ya ɗauki sake bayyana integral iri ɗaya a matsayin kuskure kai tsaye. Duba ko za ka iya ɗaukar duk furucin a matsayin lissafi mai I.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.o.b: I ya sake bayyana, saboda haka kuskure ne na lissafi kuma dole in fara daga farko.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.r.b: I ya sake bayyana da kuskuren lissafi ba abu guda ba ne. Ka tabbatar da kuskure ba tare da duba ko layukan baya daidai ba.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.o.c: Idan ka sake tsara shi a matsayin lissafi mai I, za ka samu sakamako iri ɗaya da na Jihu.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.r.c: Wannan ya ga furucin mai I a bangarorin biyu a matsayin lissafi guda.
y-m-67-09.s.s2.explain: Idan aka daidaita x² ln x − x²/2 − I da I, za a samu 2I=x² ln x−x²/2, saboda haka I=(x²/2)ln x−x²/4+C. Sakamakon Jihu iri ɗaya ne. Idan aka nemo abin da aka samu na furucin, za a samu x ln x.
y-m-67-09.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi hanyar da za ka yi amfani da ita ga wannan matsala, ka rubuta ko sakamakon hanyoyin biyun iri ɗaya ne, da dalilinka na zaɓe.
y-m-67-09.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta furucin ƙarshe na hanyoyin biyun gefe da gefe, ka kwatanta ko sun yi daidai.
y-m-67-09.s.s3.hint.1: Ƙidaya ka kwatanta ilimin farko da kowane hanya ke buƙata da adadin layukan lissafi.

y-m-67-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Dalilin zaɓina abu ne da za a iya kwatantawa, kamar tsawon lissafi ko ilimin da ake buƙata?
y-m-67-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yarda cewa ɗayan zaɓin (hanyar Haeun) ba hanya mara kyau ba ce?
y-m-67-09.s.s3.model.0: Hanyoyin biyun suna ba da (x²/2)ln x−x²/4+C, saboda haka sakamakon iri ɗaya ne. Zan zaɓi hanyar Jihu. Abin da aka samu na ln x shi ne 1/x mai sauƙi, kuma ana iya haɗa x kai tsaye, saboda haka lissafin gajere ne.
y-m-67-09.s.s3.model.1: Sakamakon ya dace. Hanyar Haeun na buƙatar sanin indefinite integral na ln x, I kuma yana sake bayyana, don haka ana buƙatar wani mataki na sake tsara shi; amma idan ka riga ka san integral na ln x, wannan ma ana iya amfani da shi. Zan yi amfani da mafi sauƙi, hanyar Jihu.

y-m-67-10.material: Bari v(t) m/s ya zama saurin robot da ke tafiya a madaidaiciyar hanya a lokacin t (daƙiƙa). Alkiblar dama ita ce +, kuma v(t) yana ci gaba. (Matsuguni shi ne canjin matsayi daga farko zuwa daga baya; nisan tafiya kuma jimillar tsawon duk tafiyar ba tare da la’akari da alkibla ba.) A ƙasa akwai ƙoƙarin nemo “jimillar nisan tafiya” idan v(t)=t−2, 0≤t≤4.
y-m-67-10.prereq.2: Ma’anar sauri, matsuguni da nisan tafiya (dangantakar sauri da matsayin da aka ratsa a Calculus I)
y-m-67-10.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin da ba daidai ba a mafita ta ƙasa. (Zai fi dacewa a zaɓi layin dalili, amma an yarda da layin sakamako ma.)
y-m-67-10.s.s1.hint.1: Fadi ko robot ɗin yana tafiya dama ko hagu a t=1.
y-m-67-10.s.s1.line.0: Jimillar nisan tafiya ita ce integral na sauri v(t) daga 0 zuwa 4.
y-m-67-10.s.s1.line.2: Saboda haka jimillar nisan tafiya 0 m ce.
y-m-67-10.s.s1.line.3: Wato robot bai motsa ko da sau ɗaya cikin daƙiƙa 4 ba.
y-m-67-10.s.s1.explain: Layi na 1 shi ne asalin kuskuren. ∫v dt shi ne canjin matsayin da robot ya yi (matsuguni); jimillar nisan tafiya kuma jimillar tsawon tafiyar ne ba tare da la’akari da alkibla ba. Lissafin layi na 2 ya nuna daidai cewa matsuguni 0 m ne. Layuka 3 da 4 sun karanta matsuguni 0 a matsayin nisan tafiya 0 ba daidai ba.
y-m-67-10.s.s2.prompt: Game da wani robot, abin da aka sani kawai shi ne “matsuguni daga t=0 zuwa t=b daƙiƙa 0 ne” (saurin yana ci gaba). Me za ka iya cewa game da jimillar nisan tafiya?
y-m-67-10.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin motsi biyu mabambanta masu matsuguni 0 (ɗayansu tsayawa ne).
y-m-67-10.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta jimillar nisan tafiya a kowane motsi.
y-m-67-10.s.s2.o.a: 0 m ne. Domin matsayi bai canza ba.
y-m-67-10.s.s2.r.a: Matsayin farko da na ƙarshe iri ɗaya ne, ba daidai yake da rashin motsi a tsakani ba.
y-m-67-10.s.s2.o.b: Ba za a tantance ba. Ko da matsuguni 0 ne, muna buƙatar ƙarin sani game da motsinsa a tsakani.
y-m-67-10.s.s2.r.b: Ka gane cewa matsuguni kaɗai ba zai gaya mana motsin da ya faru a tsakani ba.
y-m-67-10.s.s2.o.c: Nisan tafiya ya ninka matsuguni sau biyu. Domin tafiya da dawowa yana ninka nisan.
y-m-67-10.s.s2.r.c: Ka rubuta dangantakar tsawon zagayen dawowa da matsuguni ba daidai ba. Idan matsuguni 0 ne, ninki biyunsa ma 0 ne.
y-m-67-10.s.s2.explain: Ko matsuguni 0 ne, nisan tafiya na iya zama 0 (an tsaya tun farko zuwa ƙarshe) ko ya fi 0. Ana buƙatar dabarar sauri ko lokutan da alama ke canzawa.
y-m-67-10.s.s3.prompt: Akwai robot mai sauri v(t)=t−c (c>0). Zaɓi nau’i-nau’i 3 mabambanta (c,b) da matsugunin daga 0 zuwa b daƙiƙa yake zama 0. (c da b masu kyau ne; goma ma ya dace.)
y-m-67-10.s.s3.hint.0: Lissafta matsuguni kai tsaye idan c=1 da c=2, ka nemo ƙa’idar b nawa ne ninkin c idan ya zama 0.
y-m-67-10.s.s3.hint.1: Ta amfani da t=c, lokacin da v ya zama 0, a matsayin iyaka, lissafta matsugunin ɓangaren farko da na baya dabam.

y-m-67-10.s.s3.fail.c1: c da b dole su fi 0.
y-m-67-10.s.s3.fail.c2: Matsuguni daga 0 zuwa b daƙiƙa ba 0 ba ne.
y-m-67-10.s.s3.explain: Matsugunin ∫₀ᵇ(t−c)dt=b²/2−cb=b(b−2c)/2, saboda haka 0 ne idan b=2c. Nisan tafiya a lokacin ∫₀^(2c)|t−c|dt=c²; da yake c>0, koyaushe ya fi 0.
y-m-67-10.s.s3.because.prompt: Zaɓi ɗaya daga (c,b) da ka ƙirƙira, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa matsuguni 0 ne amma jimillar nisan tafiya ba 0 ba ne, sannan ka nemo nisan tafiya (m) a wannan yanayin.
y-m-67-10.s.s3.because.hint.0: Rubuta tsawon tafiyar robot a kowane tazara a matsayin lamba mai kyau, ka haɗa.
y-m-67-10.s.s3.because.hint.1: Da farko nemo lokacin da saurin ya zama 0 a misalin da ka zaɓa.
y-m-67-10.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana ta fuskar alkibla dalilin da ya sa matsuguni 0 da nisan tafiya 0 suka bambanta?
y-m-67-10.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: A lissafin nisan tafiya, ka ƙara tsawon tazara mara kyau a matsayin lamba mai kyau?
y-m-67-10.s.s3.because.selfAssess.2: Ka lissafta nisan tafiya da kanka da (c,b) da na zaɓa?
y-m-67-10.s.s3.because.model.0: Idan c=2 da b=4, cikin daƙiƙa 2 na farko saurin mara kyau ne, don haka yana tafiya 2 m hagu; cikin daƙiƙa 2 na ƙarshe saurin mai kyau ne, don haka yana dawowa 2 m dama. Matsuguni 0 ne, amma nisan tafiya gaba ɗaya 2+2=4 m ne.
y-m-67-10.s.s3.because.model.1: Idan c=1 da b=2, cikin daƙiƙa 1 na farko alamar sauri mara kyau ce, saboda haka yana koma 1/2 m; a daƙiƙa 1 na gaba ya dawo 1/2 m ya koma inda ya fara. Nisan tafiya 1/2+1/2=1 m ne, wato c².

y-m-67-05.material: A ɗauki m(a) derivative ne a x=0 na f(x)=aˣ (a>0, a≠1). Bisa ma’ana m(a) ita ce ƙimar da (aʰ−1)/h ke kusantowa idan h kusa da 0. Ƙimomin da ke ƙasa ƙiyasi ne da h=0.000001.
y-m-67-05.thinking.2: Bayyana lambobi da ma’ana da lissafi

y-m-67-05.s.s1.prompt: Subin ya haddace (aˣ)′=x·aˣ⁻¹. Saka x=0 yana ba m(a)=0. Amma idan a=2, (2ʰ−1)/h kusan 0.718, 0.696, 0.693 ne ga h=0.1, 0.01, 0.001. Yaya za ka tantance ƙa’idar Subin?
y-m-67-05.s.s1.hint.0: Daga canjin lambobin, duba inda ƙima ke tafiya yayin h ke raguwa 0.1, 0.01, 0.001.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.hint.1: Sanya ƙimar ƙa’idar Subin a x=0 da ƙimomin tebur gefe da gefe ka kwatanta.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.o.a: 0.693 yana kusa da 0, don haka ƙa’idar Subin tana iya zama daidai.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka lura cewa ko da h ya ragu, ƙimar ba ta zuwa 0, tana kusa da 0.693?
y-m-67-05.s.s1.o.b: Ƙimomin tebur suna kusa da 0.69, don haka ƙa’idar ba daidai ba ce.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka ɗauki raguwar h a matsayin shaida cewa ƙima tana manne da wata lamba tabbatacciya maimakon 0.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.o.c: h ba 0 ba ne, saboda haka tebur ba shi da ma’ana, a gaskata ƙa’idar da aka haddace
y-m-67-05.s.s1.r.c: Derivative ita ce ƙimar da ake kusantowa idan h ya kusanci 0. Tebur shaida ce mai nuni zuwa wannan ƙima.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.explain: Ko da h ya ragu, ƙima tana taruwa kusa da 0.693, ba 0 ba. Don haka a x=0, ƙa’idar Subin x·aˣ⁻¹=0 ba ta yi daidai da gangarar tangent idan a=2 ba.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.prompt: Nemo a mai m(a)=1. Duba hukuncinka yayin bayanai ke bayyana ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.hint.0: A kowane mataki, a layi guda faɗi ko sabon bayani yana goyon bayan hasashe ko yana ƙaryata shi.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.hint.1: A a iri ɗaya, rubuta ƙimar tebur da ln a gefe da gefe, kwatanta girman bambancinsu.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.info: m(2)≈0.693, m(3)≈1.099, m(4)≈1.386. Yayin a ke ƙaruwa, m(a) ma yana ƙaruwa.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.ask: Kusan ina ne a mai m(a)=1 yake?
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.after: m(2)<1<m(3), don haka amsar tana tsakanin 2 da 3. Amma wanne gefe ya fi kusa hasashe ne tukuna.

y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.r.a: m(2)≈0.693 bai kai 1 ba. m yana ƙaruwa tare da a, don haka ba sai a fi 2 domin a kai 1 ba?
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.o.b: Tsakanin 2 da 3, kuma yana kama da ya fi kusa da 3.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya yi amfani da cewa 1 ya fi kusa da 1.099 fiye da 0.693.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.o.c: Tsakanin 3 da 4, domin m(3) bai kai 1 ba tukuna.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.r.c: m(3)≈1.099 ya riga ya wuce 1. Duba inda ta fara wucewa 1.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.o.d: Abin da za a iya cewa kawai shi ne tsakanin 2 da 3.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.r.d: Wannan hukunci ne mai taka-tsantsan, domin maki uku ba su nuna ainihin wurin ba.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.after: m(2.7)<1<m(2.8), don haka amsar tana tsakanin 2.7 da 2.8. Tebur ba zai ƙayyade ainihin ƙima ba.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.o.a: a=2.75 ita ce ainihin amsar, tana daidai a tsakiyar 2.7 da 2.8.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Wannan ya tabbatar da cewa ƙima da ba ta cikin teburin ita ce ainihin ƙima. Dole a duba ainihin ƙimar m a 2.75.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Da alama tana tsakanin 2.7 da 2.8, amma ba za a iya kayyade ainihin ƙimar da tebur ba.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Wannan ya ƙuntata zangon tare da yarda da iyakar teburin.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Ƙimar da ta zama 1 daidai ba ta cikin teburin, saboda haka babu irin wannan a.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.r.c: m(a) yana sauyawa a ci gaba bisa a, saboda haka rashin kasancewar ƙima a teburin ba yana nufin ba ta samuwa ba.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.info: Ana kiran lambar da m(a)=1 take e, kuma e≈2.71828…. Haka kuma m(a)=ln a (logarithm na a na halitta), saboda haka (aˣ)′=aˣ ln a. Idan aka kwatanta da teburin, ln 2≈0.693, ln 3≈1.099, ln 2.7≈0.993.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.ask: Ta yaya dabarar Subin ta asali take idan aka kwatanta da wannan sakamako?
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.after: A x=0, dabarar Subin kullum 0 ce, amma ainihin gangara ita ce ln a. Idan a≠1, to ln a≠0, saboda haka dabarar Subin ba daidai ba ce. m(a)=1 idan ln a=1, wato a=e.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Ana iya cewa dabarar Subin daidai ce a x=0 ne kawai idan a=e.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Idan a=e, to m=1, amma dabarar Subin tana bayar da 0 a x=0. Duba ko har yanzu daidai ce.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Kamanceceniyar ƙimomin teburin da ƙimomin ln a daidaituwa ce kawai.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Yana da wuya a ɗauki amincewar ƙimomi ukun har zuwa wuri na uku bayan maki goma a matsayin daidaituwa.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.o.c: A x=0, dabarar Subin tana bayar da 0, ainihin ƙimar kuma ln a (≠0) ce; saboda haka dabarar ba daidai ba ce.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Ka tabbatar da bambancin da teburin lambobi ya nuna ta amfani da magana.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.reflect: Tsarin shi ne: da farko amincewa da dabarar da aka haddace, ƙaryata ta da lambobi, ƙuntata zangon da tebur, sannan ma'anar (e) da magana mai bayanin tebur. A wane mataki tabbacin da kake da shi ya sauya? Menene bambanci tsakanin aikin tebur da na maganar?
